checklist.criterion: State is a discriminated union: The four states are modelled as a union with a `status` discriminant, each carrying only the fields valid for that state (no shared optional fields for `socket`/`error`/`retryCount` on other members)
`transition` is exhaustive with a `never` guard: `transition` switches on `status` and its default branch assigns to a `never`-typed variable
`send` only accepts the `"connected"` member: `send`'s state parameter is typed as `Extract<ConnectionState, { status: "connected" }>` (or equivalent narrowed type), not the full union
Compile-error case is demonstrated: A commented-out call passing a full-union-typed state to `send` is included with a note that it fails to compile
No `any` or unsafe assertions introduced: The solution contains no `any`, `@ts-ignore`, or unchecked `as` assertions
